tonight.headline: Down 66.6 with Allen and Jefferson to come — a 7% chance
body: Bad news first: the early games went against you. Allgeier had 5 carries for 3.9 at the snapshot, Diggs 3 catches on 5 targets (8.1) in a 20-13 loss to the Rams, and Ollie Gordon 7.4 in a 19-9 loss at Detroit. Garrett Wilson sat out with the concussion as expected. Talla Metralla have 130.22 to your 63.6.

Nothing is left to set: every Sunday starter is locked and Allen and Jefferson are already in for Monday, with Carson Wentz throwing to Jefferson. ESPN projects the finish at 117.5 to 161.5. The live decision of the week is Tuesday's claim (Denzel Boston, below).

case.label: The script that wins it
case.body: Talla Metralla still have Golden (24.6 already at New England) and D'Andre Swift on Sunday night. You need Allgeier, Fairbairn, Allen and Jefferson to out-score them by about 67 — roughly Allen at 35+ and Jefferson at 25+ with Swift held down.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Swift and Golden add 15+ more between them; then no Monday line from Allen and Jefferson closes it.

worthALook.name: Denzel Boston
worthALook.lead: The morning's condition fired: 7 targets with Shedeur Sanders. Tuesday's run decides the drop before claims clear Wed 02:00 CDMX.

case.label: The player
case.body: 6 catches on 7 targets, 98 yards, 15.8 at New Orleans (archive), including a 60-yard catch, with Shedeur Sanders 19/31 for 297 and 2 TDs while Watson sat with the concussion (Saints.com; Yahoo live 21:33Z). Bok-aneers cut him healthy on Saturday.

case.label: The quarterback
case.body: Watson cleared the protocol Saturday but was limited (Monken, NFL.com ~7 Nov); whether Sanders starts again in Week 10 is open. Boston drew 16.5 opportunities in Week 8 with Watson (archive), so the role does not depend on Sanders.

case.label: The drop problem
case.body: Every bench seat has a reason: Etienne's owner thesis runs to Week 11 and has not fired; Metcalf's claim thesis is decided in Week 10; Kamara just lost early downs to Estime (15 carries to 6) and is 64% owned; Wilson is a WR1 in the protocol. Chem priority resets weekly, so the claim itself costs nothing lasting.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday 16:00 run: claim Boston if Etienne's practice window is still unopened, dropping Etienne with his thesis addressed on the record — or Kamara if Estime is confirmed the Saints' lead. Pass if Watson is named the Week 10 starter and Boston's Week 8 role with him is shown to be a fluke.

worthALook.name: Caleb Douglas
worthALook.lead: Miami's target leader two weeks running — but Chem's WR room is full once Pittsburgh and Wilson are back.

case.label: The player
case.body: 6 catches on 8 targets, 70 yards in Week 9 (archive), his second game leading Miami; 20% target share and 34% of air yards before it (NBC 6 Nov). Dropped a fourth-down ball late (Yahoo).

case.label: Why not a claim

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Wilson still in the protocol on Wednesday and Metcalf losing targets to a returning Pittman — then a second receiver add is a starter, and Douglas versus Boston becomes the question.
